specification_purpose: Preregister the v6 confirmatory-evaluation protocol: the scope rule, the window definition and readiness test, the data path including the window benchmark series, the unchanged evaluation rule, the single confirmatory decision criterion, the reporting and falsifiers, and the authorization boundary. This artifact authorizes no evaluation, no window read and no benchmark retrieval before the window exists.

evaluation_scope.selected_configuration_per_asset: the configuration evaluated for an asset is the one the v6 selection run publishes in research/v6_selected_configurations_manifest.json under the unchanged v1 selection rule; this protocol publishes before that run, so the readiness test requires the selection authorization and the selected-configurations manifest to exist and to be hash-bound before any window candle is read

window_definition.membership_rule: a candle is inside a confirmatory window when its close falls strictly after that window's start and before its end, regardless of which asset the candle belongs to; a candle that closes exactly at a window's start is development data
window_definition.overlap_rule: the v6 confirmatory window opens inside the still-open v2, v3, v4 and v5 confirmatory windows, which is not a violation: the v6 evaluation may not start before the later of the four recorded gates and the v6 window's own earliest end, the two evaluations share no asset, and no confirmatory window is ever read for selection; windows are never read for selection

benchmark.alignment_rule: the asset series and the benchmark series are sliced to the same fold window before the frozen engine is called, so that the engine's index pairing equals the UTC-candle-close alignment of docs/research_protocol.md:101
benchmark.methodology_rule: Align BTC and target asset by UTC candle close; no forward fill for missing BTC observations
fail_closed: the benchmark series is shorter than the evaluated window
the benchmark series is not index-aligned with the asset series
benchmark.grid_rule: the 576 btc_ema_168 configurations per asset are evaluated, never dropped, re-derived or re-ranked

checks: the v6 confirmatory window holds at least 2160 closed hourly candles
the v6 candidate freeze is committed and hash-bound
the v6 selection authorization exists and is bound to the v6 candidate freeze
the v6 selected-configuration manifest is committed and hash-bound
a confirmatory evaluation authorization exists and is bound to this protocol's manifest_hash
the confirmatory execution path lives outside the hashed set and its canonical digest is recorded
the v1 holdout and the v2, v3, v4 and v5 confirmatory windows are not read
the window benchmark series is retrievable, hash-verifiable and index-aligned with the asset series

decision_rule.authoritative_source_note: the v6 specification inherits the v1 selection rule unchanged, and the v1 specification is the owner of that rule
criteria: net_total_return > 0 at baseline costs (1x) over the confirmatory window
net_total_return > 0 at 2x costs over the confirmatory window
the evaluated parameters are byte-identical to the frozen v6 candidate manifest entry
decision_rule.note: The confirmatory decision is the single preregistered promotion rule, inherited unchanged from the immutable v1 specification. No second criterion (for example a buy-and-hold comparison) is stated anywhere in this document, because the v2 line had to be amended after two frozen artifacts disagreed about what passing the window means.

verdicts.survival_rule: every criterion of the single preregistered promotion rule holds
verdicts.rejected_rule: the evaluation is conclusive and at least one criterion of the single preregistered promotion rule fails
inconclusive_rules: the window data is insufficient to evaluate the configuration
the configuration produced zero closed trades on the window
verdicts.zero_trade_rule: a configuration with zero closed trades is INCONCLUSIVE and never REJECTED_ON_HOLDOUT: a never-traded strategy is not reported as a failure, because the data cannot support that claim
verdicts.low_trade_count_rule: a configuration with 1 to 29 closed trades fails the closed_trades >= 30 criterion and is REJECTED_ON_HOLDOUT

falsifiers: a confirmatory evaluation omits one of the in-scope candidates
an asset excluded at validation is hidden from the report
the grid is extended, re-tuned or re-ranked on the window
a candle inside the window is read more than once
holdout_exposed_count is incremented outside a confirmatory read
the window benchmark series is missing, short or misaligned and the evaluation proceeds anyway
the 576 btc_ema_168 configurations per asset are dropped
the v1 holdout or the v2, v3, v4 or v5 confirmatory window is read
a second confirmatory decision criterion is applied
the v1/v2 BTC-alignment deviation is repaired instead of disclosed
the v6 evaluation starts before the later of the four earlier gates and the v6 window's own earliest end

deviation_disclosure.scope: the completed v1 and v2 runs
deviation_disclosure.statement: The completed v1 and v2 runs evaluated the BTC trend filter against a BTC EMA taken from a different period; the deviation is a disclosure for the final report and is not repaired here.
deviation_disclosure.v6_run_alignment: the v6 run evaluates the BTC trend filter against the index-aligned v6 benchmark dataset

authorization_boundary.statement: This protocol authorizes nothing. It preregisters how the confirmatory evaluation will be performed once the window exists. No candle inside the window may be read, no benchmark series may be retrieved, and no evaluation may be run, under this protocol.

code_hash_constraint.note: The identity of the hashed source set is the canonical source digest, which is portable across checkouts. The checkout-dependent ordered digest compute_code_hash() stays the authorized value of record and is never recomputed as a drift signal.

supersedes.reason: The v6 selection run selects at most one configuration per asset of the frozen v6 candidate set. The confirmatory protocol evaluates exactly the published candidates on the v6 confirmatory window; the selection run remains the preceding, immutable step.

durability.rule: The protocol takes effect when this artifact is committed. No confirmatory-window candle may be read and no evaluation may run before the commit that carries this artifact exists.
durability.note: The commit hash is recorded by the committing session. This artifact is not rewritten after that commit, because its manifest_hash must not change.

hashing.note: manifest_hash is the sha256 of the document body with manifest_hash removed, so the document does not hash itself into a cycle.
